overview: Self-hosted web UI for building, running, and inspecting AI coding agents with pluggable tools and models.
description:
DeepSeek Harness is an open-source agent harness from DeepSeek AI for building, running, and inspecting AI agents in real-world environments. It provides a browser-based UI, plugin-based runtime composition, session traces, and tooling for models, skills, sandboxes, storage, and workflows.

This Websoft9 package deploys DeepSeek Harness as a single container built from the official Node.js 22 image and the upstream `@deepseek-ai/dsh` npm distribution. Persistent state such as sessions and attachments is stored in the `dsh_home` volume, and a dedicated `/workspace` volume is provided as the default working directory for projects opened in the UI.

Typical use cases include evaluating coding agents, experimenting with agent tooling and workflows, creating plugin-based harness presets, and running a self-hosted agent workbench for development teams.
